# GrantThai — full discovery text for AI agents

> GrantThai is an independent, unofficial project. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to NRCT, TSRI, any PMU, or NRIIS. / GrantThai เป็นโครงการอิสระ ไม่เป็นทางการ และไม่ผูกพันกับ วช. สกสว. หน่วยบริหารจัดการทุน (PMU) ใด ๆ หรือระบบ NRIIS
>
> See NOTICE for the full statement.

## What this is

GrantThai helps any person turn a real problem into one work object
(`work.yaml`), checked against GrantThai's own rules, then renders it
through the route the person chooses to exactly one file:
`build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md` (academic article), `build/NRIIS_SUBMISSION.md`
(NRIIS research proposal) or `build/RESEARCH_CONCEPT_NOTE.md` (concept
note). Entering NRIIS is no longer the core but one route of the router
(founder reframe 2026-09-25: "การลงใน NRIIS ไม่ใช่แกนหลักอีกต่อไป แต่เป็นแค่
ทางเลือกหนึ่งของ router เพราะเราจะเปิดให้ตั้งแต่การทำบทความวิชาการด้วย").
Status: v0.3.0 (the router and the 7SSA structure profiles; not yet on a
package index); the engine, CLI, agent skill (skills/grantthai/), MCP server and local HTTP API work; the web
form, launchers and Citizen Mode are deferred. It never submits anything
automatically, to NRIIS or to any journal; a human always makes the final
decision and performs the final submission.

Developer / maintainer: Yaoharee Lahtee (เยาฮารี หละตี), ORCID
0009-0005-3861-0626. Developing organisation: ARAYA NIKAH SOCIAL
ENTERPRISE CO. (อารยานิกะห์ วิสาหกิจเพื่อสังคม). Purpose: "พัฒนาเพื่อให้เป็น
ประโยชน์กับคนไทยทุกคนในการพัฒนาความรู้" / "Developed to benefit every Thai
person in developing knowledge." Joint work: ผลงานร่วมกับ
ศูนย์ความรู้พลเมืองปัญญาประดิษฐ์ ซึ่งเป็นศูนย์ของ อารยานิกะห์ วิสาหกิจเพื่อสังคม
(a joint work with ศูนย์ความรู้พลเมืองปัญญาประดิษฐ์, a centre of ARAYA
NIKAH SOCIAL ENTERPRISE CO.).

## Philosophy (verbatim)

1. "GrantThai lowers the entry barrier to research, not the standard of research."
2. "Toledo connects lived experience with academic knowledge through
   translation — by people, and optionally with AI assistance — while
   evidence, methodology, and human expertise remain the gates to
   verifiable knowledge."

"Toledo" here means the conceptual framework only. GrantThai contains no
Toledo-registered equations and no proofs — see docs/lineage.md.

## The one-input, one-output-per-route contract (the router)

- "Router" means a deterministic OUTPUT ROUTE chosen by a person, declared
  in work.yaml (`routing`) or on the command line (`--route`). No AI and
  no tool ever picks a route; when the choice is ambiguous the tool stops
  and lists the candidates (MCP and HTTP return the list). An AI helping a
  researcher lists the routes and asks; it never chooses.
- ONE INPUT: `work.yaml` (spec/work/work.schema.json, 0.3, a superset of
  project.yaml 0.2) is the only canonical input. A legacy project.yaml is
  read unchanged as the NRIIS route; a directory holding both stops build.
  The Markdown forms, questionnaires, and any optional AI assistant are
  all editors of this one file, never separate inputs.
- ONE COMMAND PER ROUTE: `grantthai build <work.yaml> --route <id>`
  (routes: academic-article, nriis-proposal, concept-note; `grantthai
  route list` prints them).
- ONE OUTPUT PER ROUTE: build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md (a manuscript overview of
  the researcher's own records; `manuscript_ready` = no BLOCK, never
  "accepted"), build/NRIIS_SUBMISSION.md (every field by NRIIS tab;
  `submittable` against the bound fund profile only), or
  build/RESEARCH_CONCEPT_NOTE.md (never submittable). Each build writes
  exactly one self-contained, copy/paste-ready file with a readiness
  summary at the top and leaves the other routes' files byte-identical. No
  second GrantThai-generated file is needed to use a route's output
  (attachments and figures are the person's own files, listed with their
  status). Identity and team data live in work.yaml (PROFILE.*, ARTICLE.*
  fields); an optional local profile.yaml only pre-fills them and is never
  read by build. `routing` is outside content_sha256, so choosing a route
  never makes a review stale. See spec/contracts/one-input-one-output.md
  (0.3.0-draft) for the full contract.
- No invented journal facts: GrantThai ships no venue registry and names
  no journal, index, fee or word limit. A venue requirement enters only
  through the researcher's ARTICLE.VENUE.TARGET record with the source
  they supplied (rule ART010); otherwise NEEDS_VERIFICATION. GrantThai
  never composes an article's section text and never reformats citations.
  The NOTICE constant is body line 1 of every route; the article route
  adds its own line: GrantThai is not affiliated with any journal or
  publisher.
- 7SSA structure profiles (academic-article route, v0.3.0): for a
  conceptual-family article the researcher may select one of four 7SSA
  (seven-sector scholarly article) layouts, `7ssa-world`, `7ssa-thai-7`,
  `7ssa-thai-5` or `7ssa-thai-4` (`routes/academic-article/profiles/`), in
  `routing.structure_profiles` or with `--structure-profile`. The router only
  lists candidates (INFO RT004); the researcher selects. The output is still
  one `build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md`; rules 7SSA-01..7SSA-10 are REVIEW or INFO,
  never BLOCK; `build --format tex` writes `build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.tex`
  instead, from the sha256-pinned glosa GLOSA-7SSA template, with a visible
  unofficial-draft line under the title. With no profile selected nothing
  changes. Sources: `docs/sources.md`, `templates/tex/SOURCE.yaml`.

## AI is optional everywhere (never required)

Every AI-assisted convenience has a human-only equivalent that ships in
the same or an earlier version (spec/common/parity.yaml, README.md parity
table). AI output is never SOURCE and never moves a field above DRAFT on
its own (spec/common/status_permissions.yaml, "hard_ceiling"). AI critique
is never recorded as an independent review of a research project. These are ADVISORY flags in this file and
in ai.json (principle P11) — the actual enforcement lives in the status
permission code and CI (tools/ci/check_no_ai_import.py and the other
guards), not in this text.

## No AI/vendor attribution, anywhere

No Co-Authored-By trailer naming an AI vendor, no Claude-Session line, no
"Generated with ..." footer, in any commit, PR, file, or release note.
.githooks/commit-msg enforces this at commit time; tools/ci/check_attribution.py
enforces it in CI, across full git history, tracked files, and PR
title/body. The only sanctioned place any AI model is named is the Core
Epistemic Structure role-disclosure block in docs/lineage.md and the
README footers — role disclosure only, never authorship.

## For an AI builder starting from zero

Read, in order: AGENTS.md → docs/design/PLAN.md (historical design plan;
§N is the router addendum) → GRANTTHAI_STANDALONE.md → docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md
→ spec/INDEX.yaml → routes/INDEX.yaml → the specific spec/** files needed
→ docs/deviations.md.
Do not invent Thai facts (agency rules, NRIIS labels) or journal facts
from training-data recall; write NEEDS_VERIFICATION and cite
docs/sources.md instead.

## Ecosystem position

GrantThai bridges Problem/Knowledge → Researchable project →
Funding-aligned project (when the route needs a fund) → route-ready
output (article, NRIIS proposal or concept note; NRIIS is one route),
between the founder's
conceptual Toledo Open Research & Knowledge Ecosystem and the
national/sector Thailand Research & Innovation ecosystem. See
docs/ecosystem.md (TH+EN) and ecosystem/ecosystem.yaml. GrantThai never
submits to NRIIS, never decides PI eligibility (that is the bound fund
profile's job, rule ELIG001), and never grants any certification or
official status.
